_about: 运镜配方(app/core/camera_recipes.py)：叙事类别 + 强度 → 一条组合运镜。angles / rhythms 每行是 [代码认的 id, 中文写法, 英文写法]，顺序也是从自由文本认机位的顺序(先命中的胜出)。categories 的顺序就是给前端列出的顺序；键是类别 id，levels 每档是 [运镜(camera_motion 里的标准名), 机位 id, 节奏 id, 中文动作提示, 英文动作提示]。打斗节奏的中档不环绕：两人同框一绕就跨过轴线，左右对调，所以跟着闪避的方向横移。打斗高潮不环绕、不定格：环绕跨轴，定格把动作停死；力量靠急推、骤停和冲击时的震动。intensities 是 [强度 id, 中文名]。quality_zh / quality_en 是两种语言提示词结尾的质感句，negative_en 是负面句。says 是句子模板，花括号里是代码填进去的值：prompt_zh / prompt_en 组出配方提示词，signature 是相邻镜运镜撞款时报出的签名，default_environment / default_lighting 是镜头没写环境、光影时的默认句。
rhythms: long hold then a short burst

entrance.label: 人物出场
entrance.purpose: 交代人物气场与情绪起点

strong: 快速推向面部，眼神锐利
rapid push-in to the face, sharp eyes
medium: 缓慢靠近人物，表情逐渐清晰
slow push-in, expression comes into focus
soft: 缓慢环绕，衣摆与发丝随风
slow orbit, cloth and hair moving in the wind

tracking.label: 移动跟拍
tracking.purpose: 人物在空间中移动，环境持续变化

strong: 贴地紧跟冲刺，地面速度感明显
medium: 侧面平行跟拍行走，环境掠过
side tracking of the walk, environment sliding by
soft: 从背后缓缓跟随，空间渐渐展开
gentle follow from behind, space opening up

dialogue.label: 对话视角
dialogue.purpose: 把观众放进对话的一方

strong: 越过前景肩膀缓推，视线落在对方脸上
over-the-shoulder slow push onto the listener's face
medium: 过肩固定，前景肩膀轻微虚化
locked over-the-shoulder, foreground shoulder softly blurred
soft: 平视双人固定，两人视线在中心相交
eye-level two-shot, eyelines meeting at centre

opening.label: 大片开场
opening.purpose: 空间一次展开，建立世界观

strong: 高空俯冲到人物身边，空间瞬间展开
aerial dive down to the character, space unfolds at once
medium: 由低到高抬升，完整交代人物与环境
crane up revealing character and environment
soft: 从近景缓缓拉远，人物在空间中变小
slow dolly out from close-up to wide

transition.label: 转场慢镜
transition.purpose: 以运镜完成时空切换或情绪定格

strong: 快速甩动带出方向性模糊接下一场
whip pan with directional blur into the next scene
medium: 快速横移带动动态模糊切换空间
fast lateral move with motion blur switching space
soft: 时间放慢，镜头环绕定格瞬间
slowed time, camera orbiting the frozen instant

strong: 镜头跟剑锋走，出手瞬间短促急推后骤停
camera rides the blade, a short burst on the strike then a hard stop
medium: 人物侧身闪避，镜头顺着闪避方向同速横移
character dodges, camera trucks with the dodge at the same speed
soft: 聚焦手与剑柄，剑刃缓缓出鞘
close on hand and hilt, blade slowly unsheathed

strong: 贴地低机位，出手瞬间短促急推、击中时骤停，镜头随冲击一震，碎屑朝镜头飞散
ground-level burst push-in on the strike, hard stop on impact, camera jolts as debris flies toward the lens
medium: 冲击瞬间轻微震动，力量感直接
slight shake on impact, direct sense of force
soft: 击中瞬间慢放半拍再回到正常速度，动作不停，机位不动
a half-beat speed ramp on impact back to full speed, the action never stops, camera holds

strong: 缓慢推近至眼睛，瞳孔反光与情绪变化
slow push to the eyes, reflections and emotion shifting
medium: 固定窗边侧拍，柔光洒落，人物静止
static side shot by the window, soft light, still figure
soft: 固定镜头中背影慢慢远去，空间空下来
locked frame, the back slowly walks away, space empties

detail.label: 细节叙事
detail.purpose: 由物件和局部承接剧情信息

strong: 从关键物件特写缓慢移到人物脸部
slow move from the object close-up to the face
medium: 聚焦手部握物、松手或轻触
close on the hand gripping, releasing or touching
soft: 镜头藏在门边观察，前景虚化
camera hidden by the door frame, foreground blurred

fantasy.label: 奇幻特效
fantasy.purpose: 仙侠、奇幻、赛博的氛围镜头

strong: 穿过霓虹街景或云层快速抵达人物
flying through neon streets or clouds to the character
medium: 花瓣、火焰或雪花环绕人物，镜头缓慢移动
petals, flames or snow around the character, slow camera
soft: 从水面倒影缓缓上移显露真实人物
tilt up from the reflection to reveal the real figure

strong: 360 度环绕人物，完整展示动作、造型与场景
360 orbit fully showing action, look and scene
medium: 从人物中心慢慢拉远到巨大环境
slow pull out from the character to the vast environment
soft: 固定远景，人物立于天地之间
locked wide, the figure between earth and sky

quality_zh: 电影级质感，细节丰富，自然运动，浅景深，运动模糊自然，稳定流畅
quality_en: cinematic lighting, film grain, shallow depth of field, natural motion blur, smooth, 4k
negative_en: static camera, no movement, locked frame, flat angle, flat lighting, no emotion

says.default_environment: 环境随镜头运动持续变化
